_comment: Copy this file to config.json (or set ARTEX_CONFIG to use another path). This file only contains database and skill_dir; configure LLM and other settings through environment variables or the app.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: ARTEX_PG_DSN environment variable > database in this file. Choose one format: (A) fill in the fields below; (B) set database.dsn to a complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Format (B): replace the database fields above with a complete DSN. If dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Root directory for skills (each subdirectory contains one skill and its SKILL.md). Priority: ARTEX_SKILL_DIR environment variable > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved from the current working directory.
